# felt + Shuttle

> felt keeps project notes, decisions, and tasks as Markdown files in Git. Shuttle, an optional layer on top, runs coding agents against those notes on one machine or across a fleet.

- **felt** is a Git-backed wiki and memory store: each note is a **fiber** under `.felt/`, managed with `felt init`, `add`, `show`, `edit`, `ls`, `find`, `tree`, `nest`, and `sync`. Works standalone with no background service.
- **Shuttle** turns fibers carrying a `shuttle:` block (**constitutions**) into live coding-agent sessions (**workers**) launched by a per-host **daemon**. Constitutions nest into parent/child **threads**, communicate via `shuttle message`/`post`/`board`, share files and `tapestry.html` summary pages, and support **ambient mode** (`shuttle host ambient on`) so ordinary sessions can adopt themselves with `shuttle adopt`.
- **Three UI layers**: Layer 1 is the `shuttle` CLI and Core HTTP API (`/api/v1/contract`); Layer 2 is the unstyled UI primitives SDK served at `/sdk/shuttle-sdk.js`; Layer 3 is the default board (Desk and Channels) and user-authored pages under `~/.config/shuttle/ui/<name>/`.

## Agent playbooks

- [Agent setup checklist](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/shuttle/agent-setup/): step-by-step guide for installing felt, setting up the Shuttle daemon, preparing a store, and putting setup on the board
- [Interactive tutorial](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/tutorial/): 7-module hands-on tutor protocol (disposable sandbox, cheapest installed model at low effort, asks before changing host config)

## Start

- [Home](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/): conceptual overview of felt, Shuttle, and the three UI layers
- [Setup & Tutorial](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/getting-started/): agent prompts for setup and the interactive tutorial, plus the manual felt quickstart
- [Agents & Plugin](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/agents/): Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, and Pi integration (skills and hooks)

## felt concepts

- [Fibers](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/concepts/fibers/): file format, ULIDs, slugs, and `[[wikilinks]]`
- [Organizing](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/concepts/organizing/): when to split, nest, or link notes
- [Frontmatter](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/concepts/frontmatter/): felt's fields and custom project metadata
- [Roles](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/concepts/roles/): offices, charters, and who answers for open work
- [Companions](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/concepts/companions/): plots, PDFs, and files kept beside a note
- [Changes](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/concepts/changes/): packaging a Git diff with a reading story
- [Constitution themes](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/concepts/themes/): CSS themes for channels and constitutions
- [Cross-project stores](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/concepts/cross-project/): sharing one felt store across repositories

## Shuttle

- [Constitutions](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/shuttle/constitutions/): writing goals (`## Desired State`), kinds (`oneshot` / `standing`), channels, and seats
- [Lifecycle](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/shuttle/lifecycle/): launch, handoff, close, rest, review, thread orchestration, and boot quarantine
- [The board](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/shuttle/board/): Desk, Channels, reader, and settings
- [UI layers & SDK](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/shuttle/ui-architecture/): CLI/API, `/sdk/shuttle-sdk.js`, board views, and personal UIs
- [Opening conversations](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/shuttle/conversations/): Rex, tmux, optional Kitty opener, and Claude Remote Control
- [Connect your machines](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/shuttle/remotes/): Tailscale discovery, SSH fallback, and shared clusters
- [Cycles and eras](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/shuttle/cycles/): named spans of time
- [Telemetry and the ledgers](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/shuttle/telemetry/): host-local event, session, and commit records
- [Installation reference](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/shuttle/installation/): prebuilt releases, source builds, and daemon supervision
- [Configuration reference](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/shuttle/configuration/): stores, agents, host classes, ambient mode, store auto fast-forward, remotes, and personal UIs
- [Sharp edges](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/shuttle/troubleshooting/): common symptoms and fixes

## Reference

- [CLI reference](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/reference/cli/): every `felt` and `shuttle` command
- [Daemon HTTP API](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/reference/api/): Core routes and daemon endpoints
- [Core OpenAPI contract](https://github.com/cailmdaley/felt/blob/main/contract/shuttle-api.json): machine-readable schema served at `GET /api/v1/contract`

## Development

- [Architecture](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/dev/architecture/): stores, the `shuttle:` block, transport/terminal tiers, and pages
- [UI SDK in the board](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/dev/ui-sdk/): how the board uses `@ui-sdk/*`
- [The board's elements](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/dev/elements/): thread row, post, file, and time proportions
- [Harnesses](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/dev/harnesses/): what each agent CLI adapter supports
- [Dispatch internals](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/dev/dispatch/): poller eligibility, prompts, and lifecycle writes
- [Operating the daemon](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/dev/operating/): health checks and symptom debugging
- [Building and deploying](https://cailmdaley.github.io/felt/dev/build-and-deploy/): make targets and fleet deploys
- [Contributing](https://github.com/cailmdaley/felt/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): local development setup
